reporting_basis: SOLO / STANDALONE. Determined 2026-08-26 by matching the total assets and total regulatory capital this dataset records against the balance sheets and Basel-III CRAR disclosures in the bank's own FY2024 audited financial statements (firstsbank-annual-report-2024.txt, printed pp.6 and 62-63). Evidence: FY2023 total assets of 659,114.06mn (already stored in 2023_Q4.json) match this report's Solo 'BALANCE SHEET' comparative column exactly (659,114,061,504); the Solo 'A. Total Regulatory Capital' comparative column for FY2023 (40,674,859,096) also matches this dataset's stored total_capital (40674.86mn) exactly. The Consolidated Balance Sheet and Consolidated CRAR disclosure in the same report show different FY2023 figures (Consolidated total assets/liabilities+equity approx. 660,110.64mn; Consolidated Total Regulatory Capital 40,896,434,594) -- confirming Solo and Consolidated are genuinely different bases here (the bank has two subsidiaries, First Security Islami Capital & Investment Ltd. and First Security Islami Exchange Italy S.R.L.) and that every year in this dataset (which has always cited '(Solo)'-labelled tables) is on the Solo basis.
notes: annual_reports/FIRSTSBANK archive covers 2011-2024 (14 years). FY2025 confirmed unavailable and very likely permanently so -- see the 2024-2025 source entry below. Shariah-based Islamic bank; reports 'Investment' rather than conventional 'Loans and Advances', and 'Classified Investments' rather than 'NPL'. The 2019 and 2021 reports' multi-year summary tables are presented as scanned/image-based pages in the source PDFs (pdftotext extracted only garbled or empty text for these specific pages, despite the rest of each document extracting normally); those two tables were re-extracted via direct vision reading of the rendered PDF page images, cross-validated against the balance sheet identity. The FY2024 report (Yearly_statement2024.pdf) has the same problem across its ENTIRE text layer (a poor-quality OCR pass with systematic digit/letter substitution: '9'->'i'/'t', '1'->'|', stray spaces/commas inserted mid-number) rather than just isolated pages; all FY2024 figures in this dataset were vision-read from rendered page images, not from pdftotext output. PDFs for this bank were still present in the local archive (not yet cleaned up from an earlier stage of this project) and were deleted after this extraction, per project policy of not retaining downloaded PDFs once structured data has been extracted.

sources.source_document: firstsbank-annual-report-2024.txt / .pdf, downloaded from https://fsibplc.com/File/statement/yearly/Yearly_statement2024.pdf (filename 'Yearly_statement2024.pdf', 107pp, 38,814,814 bytes; live HTTP 200, byte-identical in size to the Wayback capture timestamp 20250607235935 which is also 200 -- not the truncated-at-1MiB pattern). fsibplc.com's own annual_report.php listing page (checked live 2026-08-26, and via Wayback CDX across ~30 snapshots from 2024-06-18 through 2026-03-08) never lists a FY2024 or FY2025 entry under its usual 'Annual-Report-20XX.pdf' naming -- this bank appears to have stopped publishing a bound/glossy Annual Report after FY2023, and FY2024's audited financial statements were sourced instead from its 'Yearly Statement' filing path, which is the same path used for FY2016-2023 (Yearly-Statement-2016.pdf ... Yearly_statement2023.pdf all confirmed to exist via Wayback CDX).
sources.note: PDF p.79 'Financial Highlights (Solo)' (Annexure-B) for the summary metrics; PDF p.6 Balance Sheet (Solo) for total_equity/total_liabilities cross-check; PDF p.8 Profit and Loss Account (Solo); PDF p.51 Note 8.9 for CL provisioning detail; PDF p.62-63 Note 17.5/17.5(a) for Basel-III CRAR (Consolidated and Solo). This report's text layer is badly OCR-garbled throughout (not just isolated pages); every figure used was read from vision-rendered page images (pdftoppm -r 250) rather than pdftotext output, and cross-validated against (a) this report's own internal identities (assets=liabilities+equity; Tier1+Tier2=total capital; PBT-tax=PAT; total capital/RWA=CRAR; all exact to the taka) and (b) this dataset's already-stored FY2023 figures via this report's FY2023 comparative column (paid_up_capital, total_capital, total_assets, total_liabilities, total_equity, total_deposits, total_investment all matched to within 0.00001%, i.e. no restatement). Supplementary source: firstsbank-auditors-opinion-2024.txt / .pdf, downloaded from https://www.dsebd.org/Auditors_opinion/2024/FIRSTSBANK_2024.pdf (a clean, born-digital Word-generated PDF, referenced by a DSE disclosure dated 2025-06-19 titled 'Qualified Opinion of Auditor'), used for the full text of the Auditors' Qualified Opinion / Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern / Emphasis of Matter / Other Matters paragraphs. IMPORTANT: this report contains at least one internal inconsistency that is recorded, not reconciled -- Note 8.9 and the Auditors' Report's own 'Basis for Qualified Opinion' both cite the identical Bangladesh Bank letter (DBI-06/51(2)/2025-373 dated 27/04/2025) but state different required-provision figures (BDT 49,497.92 crore per Note 8.9 vs BDT 50,994.06 crore per the Auditors' Report). There are also three different 'classified investment' figures within the same document (91.75% / BDT 559,203.17mn per Annexure-B; 83.24% / BDT 507,341.46mn per Note 8.9's CL base; ~81% / ~BDT 494,390mn per the Auditors' going-concern paragraph). See 2024_Q4.json's period_note for full detail on all of these.

sources.notes: No FY2025 annual report, audited financial statements, or 'Yearly Statement' PDF exists for First Security Islami Bank PLC as a standalone entity, and this is very likely a permanent series-end rather than a routine lag. Evidence chain, all independently verified: (1) fsibplc.com has no 'Yearly_statement2025.pdf'/'Annual-Report-2025.pdf' under any filename variant tried (confirmed 404 live); (2) DSE's price-sensitive-news archive for FIRSTSBANK (dsebd.org/old_news.php?inst=FIRSTSBANK) shows its auditor gave a Qualified Opinion with a Material-Uncertainty-Related-to-Going-Concern paragraph for FY2024 (disclosed 2025-06-19), the FY2024 AGM (originally scheduled 2025-09-15) was postponed indefinitely (disclosed 2025-08-25), Bangladesh Bank declared the bank 'non-viable' and suspended trading effective 5 November 2025 under the Bank Resolution Ordinance 2025 (disclosed 2025-11-06), a Capital Reduction Order dated 21 December 2025 wrote the bank's entire paid-up capital (BDT 1,208.14 crore) down to ZERO and cancelled all shares effective 5 November 2025 (disclosed 2025-12-24), and the bank was placed in 'Z' category on 4 January 2026 for failing to hold its AGM (the most recent disclosure found; nothing newer as of retrieval); (3) independent web search confirms Bangladesh Bank issued a Letter of Intent on 9 November 2025 for a new state-owned bank, 'Sammilito Islami Bank', merging First Security Islami Bank PLC together with Global Islami Bank PLC, Social Islami Bank PLC, Union Bank PLC, and Export Import Bank of Bangladesh PLC (EXIMBANK -- also in this dataset, confirmed independently by the agent working that bank) under the S. Alam Group-linked resolution program, with all five banks' shares written down to zero. Because the resolution/merger process was already underway before FY2025 (Jan-Dec 2025) even closed, and the bank's normal AGM/audit cycle was disrupted and then superseded by the merger, there is no realistic expectation that a standalone FY2025 'First Security Islami Bank PLC' annual report will ever be filed; any FY2025-and-later reporting for this banking business will presumably surface (if at all) under 'Sammilito Islami Bank' rather than 'FIRSTSBANK'. The latest actual financial data point found for this entity is a revised, unaudited, 9-month Q3 2025 (Jan-Sep 2025) interim statement (DSE disclosure 2025-12-14/2025-12-27) showing Consolidated NAV per share of Tk (460.18) as at 30 September 2025 after Bangladesh Bank cancelled an earlier deferral facility and forced full provisioning -- this is a partial-year, unaudited, deeply-negative-equity data point and per this project's 'quarterly only, never backfill/fabricate a year-end from a partial period' rule it was NOT used to construct a 2025_Q4.json. No 2025_Q4.json file was created for this bank.

sources.source_document: fsibplc.com/File/statement/quarterly/ and /half_yearly/ -- filenames: 1st_Quarter_21.pdf, 3rd_Quarter_21.pdf, half-yearly-statement2021.pdf (2021); 1st_Quarter_22.pdf, 3rd_Quarter_22.pdf, Half-Yearly-Statement-2022.pdf (2022); 1st_Quarter_23.pdf, 3rd_Quarter_23.pdf, Half-Yearly-Statement-2023.pdf (2023); 1st-Querter-March-2024.pdf [sic], 3rd_Quarter_24.pdf, Half-Yearly-Statement-2024.pdf (2024); 1st_Quarter_25.pdf, Half-Yearly-Statement-2025.pdf (2025, no Q3 2025 found on this path -- see the researched_confirmed_unavailable entry below on why)
sources.note: Found by browsing fsibplc.com's 'Statement' navigation link (statement.php 404s directly, but the underlying /File/statement/quarterly/ and /File/statement/half_yearly/ directory paths, discovered via Wayback CDX enumeration of fsibplc.com/File/statement/, are live and directly downloadable -- all files in this batch returned live HTTP 200, no Wayback needed). All files are clean, born-digital PDFs (not scanned/OCR-needed) with a highly consistent structure across all 5 years: CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEET, CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED PROFIT AND LOSS ACCOUNT, CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED CASH FLOW STATEMENT, CONDENSED CONSOLIDATED STATEMENT OF CHANGES IN EQUITY, then the same four statements again on a Solo (non-consolidated) basis, then shared notes (Solo notes suffixed '(a)'). Solo basis used throughout, consistent with every other year in this dataset. Every year's Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) and Q3 (Jan-Sep) filing prints BOTH a cumulative-from-Jan-1 column AND a separate discrete-single-quarter column (e.g. 'Jan'24 to Sep'24' and 'Jul'24 to Sep'24' side by side) -- both were captured (suffixes '_cumulative' and '_discrete_q'), both basis='reported' since both are directly printed by the bank, not derived by subtraction. Q1 filings only ever have one column (cumulative=discrete for a first quarter). No CRAR/Capital-to-RWA ratio and no Classified-Investment amount/percentage is disclosed anywhere in these condensed interim filings at any point in the 2021-2025 span -- the only interim asset-quality-adjacent figure available is 'Specific Provision for Classified Investment' (a P&L note sub-line, cumulative from Jan 1), captured as 'specific_provision_classified_investment_cumulative'. Cross-validated exhaustively: every filing's own prior-year-end comparative Total Assets/Equity column matches this dataset's already-stored FY2020/2021/2022/2023/2024 Q4 total_assets and total_equity figures to the taka (after rounding) -- see each quarterly JSON's period_note -- confirming Solo-basis continuity and no restatement across this entire span. See insights.json for the major finding this unlocked: a real-time-visible, accelerating deterioration through 2024 (profit swinging to a discrete Q3 2024 loss; Specific Provision for Classified Investment roughly tripling quarter-on-quarter) well before the FY2024 audited collapse, with an implied Q4-2024-alone loss (calculated by subtracting this batch's own Q3 2024 9-month cumulative profit from the already-stored FY2024 annual profit) of approximately BDT -4,608mn -- larger than the entire reported annual loss. Board-meeting dates (Q1 2025 and Half-Yearly 2025 adopted 2025-05-29 and 2025-07-30 respectively) confirm the crisis continued deepening well past FY2024 year-end: Q1 2025 alone lost BDT -5,755.73mn and Q2 2025 alone lost BDT -11,170.09mn (both un-audited), eroding Solo equity from BDT 20,069.13mn (31-Dec-2024) to just BDT 3,143.31mn (30-Jun-2025) -- these two periods are OUTSIDE this dataset's core FY2011-2024 coverage but were included as valuable, genuinely-sourced post-collapse trajectory context per this task's request.

sources.note: Found via Wayback CDX enumeration of fsiblbd.com/wp-content/uploads/. Same Consolidated-then-Solo condensed-statement structure as the 2021+ batch, confirming this format predates the fsibplc.com site redesign; earliest labels use non-'/(Loss)' phrasing ('Profit before Provision and Tax', 'Net Profit after Tax'/'Net Profit after tax' -- inconsistent capitalisation between files) and, in the very oldest (Q1 2018), a single combined 'Provision for Taxation' line instead of a Current/Deferred split -- both handled with case-insensitive, alternate-label-matching extraction and cross-validated via the balance-sheet identity and full profit-chain arithmetic (income-expense=PBPT; PBPT-provisions=PBT; PBT-tax=PAT) on every single period, all of which reconcile exactly. IMPORTANT WAYBACK TRAP ENCOUNTERED REPEATEDLY IN THIS BATCH: several of these URLs have multiple archived captures where the largest CDX-declared 'length' actually downloads as a genuinely-truncated-at-the-source stub, confirmed via response headers ('x-archive-orig-content-length: 1048576' + 'warning: 299 wayback content truncated by "length"') and pdfinfo syntax errors -- i.e. the ORIGINAL crawl, not Wayback's replay, only fetched the first 1 MiB. This is the same trap already documented in this project's Wayback-truncation memory note, but this session found it applies even when the CDX API's own reported 'length' field for that specific capture is UNDER 1,048,576 bytes (misleadingly suggesting it's fine) -- the only reliable check is downloading and running pdfinfo, not trusting CDX metadata alone. Resolved in every case by trying alternate captures/timestamps of the same or a byte-identical re-uploaded URL until one downloaded clean (verified: correct page count, zero pdfinfo syntax errors). ONE quarter could NOT be recovered this way: Q3 2018 (Third-Q-Statement-2018.pdf / Third-Q-Statement-2018-1.pdf) has FIVE independent Wayback captures across 2019-2024, all sharing the identical content digest, and all are genuinely corrupt (pdfinfo: 'Top-level pages object is wrong type (null)', zero recoverable pages) -- this appears to be a permanently corrupted file on the bank's own historical server, not a crawl-truncation artifact, since every independent crawl over 5 years captured the same broken bytes. No 2018_Q3.json was created; this is recorded as a genuine, permanent source gap, not a research shortfall. SEPARATE FINDING (not a parsing error, both sides internally consistent): each of these filings' own prior-year-end comparative Total Assets figure (e.g. Q1 2018's 31-Dec-2017 column) is consistently ~0.15-0.23% LOWER than this dataset's already-stored 2017/2018/2019_Q4.json total_assets figures. Likely explanation: the stored 2015-2019 Q4 figures in this dataset were sourced from a later annual report's multi-year 'Five-Year Summary' table (per this bank's own reporting_basis note above, which already documents a ~0.1-0.2% internal Assets-vs-Liabilities+Equity inconsistency within that same summary table), whereas these interim filings' comparative columns come directly from each year's own primary, contemporaneous Balance Sheet. This gap disappears entirely from FY2020 onward (2020_Q4.json onward was sourced from primary Balance Sheet/Annexure-B tables directly, per the reporting_basis note) -- confirmed by an exact, to-the-taka match between every 2021-2025 interim filing's comparative column and the corresponding already-stored Q4 figure. Per this project's 'record, don't reconcile' convention, this small pre-crisis discrepancy is noted here verbatim; the existing 2017/2018/2019_Q4.json files were NOT modified.
